runs.text: In twenty fifteen, Saudi roads killed thirty five people for every hundred thousand. Where is Israel? Road deaths per hundred thousand people, since two thousand. Lowest first. In two thousand, Britain is at seven. Israel, eight. The UAE, almost thirty. Iran peaks at thirty three in twenty ten. Saudi Arabia hits thirty five in twenty fifteen. Then the Gulf turns it around. The UAE falls to five. Saudi Arabia, under fifteen. Lebanon drops by more than two thirds. Syria goes the other way. Thirty two in twenty twenty three. Britain stays the champion, at two and a half. Germany, three point four. And Israel halves its rate since two thousand. What makes roads safer, cameras or culture? Tell me in the comments. So where does Israel finish? Four. The best of the Middle East on this chart.
